# Vendored Stockfish WASM

- Package: `stockfish@18.0.8`
- Upstream: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js
- Build: Stockfish 18 lite, single-threaded WASM
- License: GPL-3.0; see `COPYING.txt`
- Retrieved: 2026-08-15

Vendored files were extracted from the npm package and renamed together so the
loader resolves its adjacent WASM file without network access.
